title: Boos, Brews & Hot Barre
description: Get spooky and sweaty! 50 minute heated barre, brews, and community vibes at Hapa Yoga. Come for the Sweat, Stay for the Community.
long_description:
Get spooky and sweaty! 50 minute heated barre, brews, and community vibes at Hapa Yoga. Come for the Sweat, Stay for the Community.

About this Event

Join us at Hapa Yoga for a 50-minute heated barre class led by Keshia Lee, followed by complimentary delicious brews by Em Coffee House, Fire Cupping presentation and Informational by SAHKARA Holistic Medicine, Permanent Jewelry for purchase by Luna+Co, and post-class mingling.

EVENT DETAILS:
Sunday, October 25 | 12 PM check-in, Class to start at 12:15Location: Hapa Yoga$35 ($30 for Hapa Members)50-minute Hot Barre with Keshia LeeDress code: All black attire, grip socks recommendedBring a yoga mat, towel & water!Complimentary beverage by Em Coffee HouseFire Cupping presentation and Informational by SAHKARA Holistic MedicinePermanent Jewelry for purchase by Luna + Co
A little spooky, a lot sweaty, and the perfect way to celebrate October with Sweat / Well.

Come for the sweat. Stay for the community.
